lines.text: Codex in SpecWithCode: one task, planned, built and reviewed.
lines.spoken: Codex in Spec With Code: one task, planned, built, and reviewed.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init. It adds AGENTS.md and seven SpecWeave skills, such as sw-increment and sw-do.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init. It adds agents dot M D, and seven spec weave skills, such as S W increment, and S W do.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode and set this Mac up as your main machine. On the Codex card, click Use existing CLI to reuse your Codex sign-in. The card says Ready.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code, and set this Mac up as your main machine. On the Codex card, click Use existing C L I, to reuse your Codex sign-in. The card says: Ready.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. The project opens on its coordinator.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. The project opens on its coordinator.

lines.text: Set Full access for this demo, describe the change, and send it. The coordinator hands the work to a new thread.
lines.spoken: Set Full access for this demo, describe the change, and send it. The coordinator hands the work to a new thread.

lines.text: The thread plans increment 0001: acceptance criteria and one task with its test. Then it changes the code and runs that test. A task is done only when its test passes.
lines.spoken: The thread plans increment zero zero zero one: acceptance criteria, and one task with its test. Then it changes the code, and runs that test. A task is done only when its test passes.

lines.text: Open the thread to review it: the summary, the verification and review reports, and every changed file in Open diff.
lines.spoken: Open the thread to review it: the summary, the verification and review reports, and every changed file in Open diff.

lines.text: Increment 0001 is verified and closed. Next, run the same task with another agent.
lines.spoken: Increment zero zero zero one is verified and closed. Next, run the same task with another agent.
